statement: Calum Lill is a British actor.
Calum Lill was born in 1995 or 1996.
After graduating, Lill had guest roles in Doctors and Holby City in 2019.
Lill played the recurring role of Carlton Smith in the soap opera Hollyoaks in 2021.
Lill almost quit the acting profession due to his struggle in getting acting roles.
Lill worked various jobs in between acting, including as a car salesman.
Lill did not like working as a car salesman.
Lill was later cast as Joel Deering in the ITV soap opera Coronation Street.
Lill was very happy about being cast as Joel Deering in Coronation Street.
Lill enjoyed his experience on Coronation Street.
Lill received praise for his portrayal of the villain Joel Deering.
Lill was nominated for Inside Soap Awards for his role as Joel Deering.
Lill was nominated for a British Soap Award for his role as Joel Deering.
Lill left the role of Joel Deering at the end of the storyline in 2024.
Lill portrayed Fleshcreep in the pantomime of Jack and the Beanstalk.
In 2025, Lill announced that he would be acting in The Sociable Plover at the Old Red Lion, Islington.
In 2025, it was announced that Lill would be briefly returning to Coronation Street.
Lill comes from a working-class family.
When he was a child, Lill watched the drama Waterloo Road.
Lill considered Waterloo Road his favourite show when he was a child.
Lill revealed that all he wanted to do was get an acting job in Waterloo Road when he was growing up.
Lill revealed that his house was used as one of the sets during the early years of Waterloo Road.
Lill's family was moving out of the house when it was used as a set for Waterloo Road.
Shortly after he graduated, Lill portrayed lead guest character Chez Wilson-Needham in an episode of the BBC soap opera Doctors.
The episode of Doctors featuring Chez Wilson-Needham aired in 2019.
Lill said that filming for Doctors was two days.
Lill portrayed Conor Henson in a 2019 episode of Holby City.
Lill described his experience on Holby City as 'fantastic'.
The COVID-19 lockdown occurred in the United Kingdom.
The COVID-19 lockdown hindered Lill's plans.
Lill nearly became homeless during the pandemic due to the television industry shutting down.
Lill recalled to the Me, Myself and Hopefully You..? podcast in 2021 that acting is a hustle.
Lill recalled that a lot of theatre actors struggle because theatre only pays enough to cover rent while in the job.
Lill recalled that theatre actors then have to go back to waiting tables.
In 2021, Lill portrayed the recurring role of Carlton Smith in the soap opera Hollyoaks for 12 episodes.
In between acting roles, Lill had various jobs, including a stint working at Junkyard Golf Club.
Lill moved from London to Manchester with his girlfriend.
Lill worked alongside acting to save money for a house.
Lill found the experience of working non-acting jobs very difficult.
Lill was not happy in the non-acting job that he was doing.
Lill almost quit his acting career.
Lill auditioned for the soap opera Coronation Street at one point but was unsuccessful.
Lill was upset about being unsuccessful in his Coronation Street audition.
Lill wanted to be on Coronation Street due to being working-class and Northern.
Lill worked at a paella stand at festivals.
Lill met actors Rupert Hill and Jenny Platt at a paella stand at festivals.
Rupert Hill is the brother of the owner of the paella stand.
Rupert Hill and Jenny Platt had both appeared in Coronation Street.
The actors Rupert Hill and Jenny Platt reassured Lill that the producers of Coronation Street would contact him if they liked him.
Whilst auditioning for Coronation Street, Lill worked as a car salesman.
Lill hated working as a car salesman.
In August 2023, it was announced that Lill had joined the cast of Coronation Street as Joel Deering.
Joel Deering is a solicitor.
Joel Deering would become the new love interest for Dee Dee Bailey, played by Channique Sterling-Brown.
Lill described being cast in Coronation Street as 'incredible'.
Lill added that it was a relief that 14 or 15 years of work had paid off.
Lill auditioned for the role of Joel Deering in May 2023.
Lill initially believed that he had been unsuccessful in his audition for Joel Deering.
When Lill's agent told him that he had received the part, he fell to his knees and cried.
Lill could not speak when he heard he got the part because he was 'over the moon'.
The actor called getting a regular role on the soap the equivalent of getting his 'letter for Hogwarts'.
Lill revealed that Coronation Street spent a lot of money on the character's outfits.
Lill would wake up at 5:30am to read the scripts for Coronation Street.
Lill would arrive to work for Coronation Street at 7am.
Lill would stay at work for Coronation Street until about 8–9pm.
Joel was initially portrayed as a 'good guy'.
Joel was later revealed to be a villain who was grooming and abusing girls.
Joel had tried to murder Lauren Bolton, played by Cait Fitton.
Lauren Bolton had been presumed dead for months.
Lill had known that Joel was going to be a villain.
Lill found out how 'bad' Joel was as he got further into auditions.
Lill was initially unaware of how the plot would end as it 'kept changing'.
Lill enjoyed portraying Joel's villainous side.
Lill found portraying Joel's villainous side more fun.
Lill did not 'camp it up' due to the storyline being a serious matter.
Lill was uncomfortable with portraying some of the things that the character Joel did due to it being so dark.
The crew supported Lill with his discomfort in portraying dark aspects of Joel's character.
Lill researched for the role by watching hours of police interviews with serial killer Ted Bundy.
Lill researched for the role by speaking to the Maggie Oliver Foundation.
The Maggie Oliver Foundation is a charity that supports survivors of sexual exploitation and abuse.
Lill would listen to music to get into character, ranging from sad, melancholy and drum and bass.
Lill noted that he could no longer listen to certain music for pleasure as it would remind him of Joel.
Lill joked that several viewers had recognised him in public but did not speak to him as he plays a villain.
Lill believed that he had created 'some sort of separation' between him and the character due to being active on social media.
Lill expected to receive a negative backlash for his role.
Lill found most of the response to his role to be supportive.
Lill added that he only began to get noticed by viewers when Joel was revealed to be involved with Lauren.
Fitton and Lill got on well together.
Fitton and Lill went the 'extra mile' to make their scenes believable by distancing from each other on set.
Fitton and Lill were in character when they passed each other on set.
Lill found an episode that was mostly him and Fitton to be the most challenging part of his time on the soap.
Lill and Fitton felt 'privileged' to be 'trusted' with the challenging episode.
Lill would hide Fitton in the boot of his car when entering the set gates to protect the secret that Lauren was alive.
Lill would sneak Fitton into the building to protect the secret that Lauren was alive.
Lill joked on Instagram that he struggled to act with the child actress who played Joel's daughter Maeve Wilkinson.
Lill joked that he died 'of cuteness overload every take' when acting with Maeve Wilkinson's actress.
Lill revealed that he criticizes himself when he watches his scenes in episodes.
Lill added that he worked very hard on his role.
In July 2024, it was announced that Lill had been cast as the villain Fleshcreep in Bournemouth Pavilion's pantomime of Jack and the Beanstalk.
The pantomime of Jack and the Beanstalk ran from December 2024 to January 2025.
Lill joked that he had a 'streak' of playing villains.
Lill added that he was looking forward to doing comedy.
Lill's casting in the production sparked rumours that Lill would be exiting Coronation Street.
ITV usually does not allow actors to star in pantomimes while they are contracted.
It was reported that Lill had always meant to have a finite run on Coronation Street.
Lill's departure from Coronation Street was confirmed the month after the pantomime announcement.
The character Joel Deering was killed-off in a Whodunit mystery storyline in September 2024.
The killer of Joel Deering was revealed to be Lauren Bolton that November in a flashback episode.
Lill did not want to leave Coronation Street as he had made some good friends there.
Lill called Coronation Street 'the most incredible place to work'.
Lill called his time on Coronation Street 'the best year' of his life.
The ending of Joel's storyline changed several times.
Lill had left the show in July 2024.
Lill returned to film the flashback episode.
Lill revealed that when he left the soap, he took several of the character's outfits with permission.
Lill considered Joel's 'smart casual stuff' outfits 'nicer' than any of his own smart outfits.
Lill took home the 'soft foam' prop of the brick that was used to kill Joel.
Lill's co-stars got him several leaving presents, including a St Christopher's pendant.
Lill said that leaving his colleagues would be the most difficult thing of leaving the soap.
Lill believed that his colleagues were 'just the best in the world'.
For his role as Joel, Lill was shortlisted for 'Best Villain' at the 2024 Inside Soap Awards.
Joel being revealed as Lauren's mystery boyfriend was shortlisted for 'Best Showstopper' at the 2024 Inside Soap Awards.
Lauren's disappearance was longlisted for 'Best Storyline' at the 2024 Inside Soap Awards.
In 2025, Lill was longlisted for Villain of the Year at the British Soap Awards.
Lill made the shortlist for Villain of the Year at the British Soap Awards.
Gary Brocart-Gillatt from Inside Soap wrote that he enjoyed the 'camp touches' that Lill brought to his villainous character.
Lill spoke to James Chase at an awards ceremony.
James Chase plays Tom King in the soap opera Emmerdale.
Lill and James Chase related to playing villains in soap operas.
Lill and James Chase received hate messages online.
In November 2024, Lill appeared on Good Morning Britain.
On Good Morning Britain, Lill promoted the details of an ITV competition to viewers.
In April 2025, Lill announced that he would be acting in Tim Whitnall's play The Sociable Plover at the Old Red Lion, Islington.
The Sociable Plover is scheduled to run from 13–24 May 2025.
In April 2025, it was reported that Lill would briefly reprise his role of Joel on Coronation Street in an unknown storyline.
In October 2025, it was announced that Lill would be a celebrity judge on Worksop's Got Talent.
Lill has dated Roberta McClarron since December 2021.
Roberta McClarron works in public relations and marketing.
When he was cast on Coronation Street, Lill lived with his girlfriend and his brother.
Lill's brother knew about Joel turning out to be a villain.
Lill said that McClarron was very happy for him when he was cast on Coronation Street.
McClarron knew how much Lill was struggling emotionally due to his struggles in getting acting jobs.
McClarron got on well with Sterling-Brown.
McClarron and Sterling-Brown had a group chat with McClarron's friend called 'The Girls Featuring Calum'.
In June 2024, Lill and McClarron announced their engagement.
In September 2024, Lill paid tribute to McClarron on Instagram.
Lill thanked McClarron for supporting him and his acting career on Instagram.
Lill noted that he had not seen McClarron much during his time on Coronation Street.
McClarron supported Lill and did the housework so that Lill could put the soap first.
Lill wrote on Instagram, 'I'm so grateful to have you in my life and that you agreed to marry me. Thanks for being amazing'.
Lill said in 2024 that he was friends with actor Tyler Dobbs.
Tyler Dobbs also portrayed a villain in Coronation Street.
In May 2024, Lill took part in the AJ Bell Great Manchester Run with other Coronation Street actors.
Lill and other Coronation Street actors took part in the run to raise money for charity.
Lill filmed a video of his grandmother reacting to Joel being revealed as a villain.
The video of Lill's grandmother became popular with Coronation Street viewers.
Lill attributed the video's popularity to viewers seeing him as 'Calum the actor' rather than his character.
In the first half of 2025, Lill travelled around Southeast Asia.
